name: Curse of Silence
storyline: Set in the land of Meluvet, a solitary fighter by the name of Sazaku leaves his comrades to explain the failure of his assassination attempt. Despite having no where to go, no money and putting his life on the line, he travels alone through the dangerous countryside routes from town to town in search of a solution to his one problem. To solve a problem it is best to go to the beginning, but is he welcome at his home town?
summary: Curse of Silence was an action-RPG along the lines of early Zelda games.
